symbols.read: The short setup remains invalidated: price at 729.49 never broke 722.40, and the regime still reads BULLISH even as the 4H direction stays bearish and the combined stance sits at HOLD. The prior overhead bearish FVG at 729.82–729.88 has been cleared — open FVGs are now empty — so the immediate cap that weakened the constructive lean last read is gone, though the 1H trend has flipped down and the last 1H bar is flat. The bias stays conflicted: structurally bullish regime against a bearish 4H and a down 1H, with 722.40 the pivot keeping the bullish case alive. The test is unchanged — reclaim 737.02 to confirm the flip toward 758.44, or lose 722.40 to revive the short toward 686.36.

The short setup at 81,033.66 remains invalidated — price never reached the entry and the 1H has flipped back down, so the bearish continuation case is dead. Bias is neutral-to-constructive: the 4H stays bearish and the combined regime reads HOLD, but the bull FVG shelf at 80,772.98–81,755.01 that was the support floor has now been fully filled and removed, leaving no open FVGs. Price is holding mid-range at 82,051.24 between 81,033.66 and 84,352.00, so this remains a range-hold, not a directional trade. Invalidation: a loss of 81,033.66 revives the short toward 77,715.32; a clean break of 84,352.00 opens the upside. Versus the prior read, the 1H has flipped back down and the support FVG is gone — the range-hold stance is confirmed but the constructive nudge is withdrawn, as the floor that justified it no longer exists.

Price is holding at 2,442.36, still above the 2,403.69 lower pivot, so the prior neutral-to-cautious-long lean stands and the bearish sell setup remains invalidated. The 1H trend is up and the last candle is flat (+0.03%), a cooldown from the earlier 0.57% drop, while the 4H stays bearish and the combined read stays HOLD. The bear FVG has shifted down to 2,447.50–2,455.99, keeping overhead supply just above price, with the bull FVG at 2,399.44–2,423.16 as the demand shelf below. Bias is unchanged: neutral-to-cautious-long while 2,403.69 holds, and a sustained break below it revives the bearish 4H case toward 2,227.50.

Bias flips to bearish: the 105.05–105.13 bull FVG that anchored the prior bullish lean is gone, leaving no open FVGs and price at 105.44 with the 4H still bearish and the combined read now HOLD rather than long. The 107.16 trigger has been reclassified as the lower pivot and the entry for a short setup, with 113.40 as the upper pivot — the prior path toward 107.16 then 113.40 is dead, not deferred. The short entry at 107.16 with stop 107.19 and target 100.92 is marked invalidated, so no trade is live at current levels. Invalidation of the bearish lean is a reclaim of 107.16; until then the downside opens 100.92, and the loss of the FVG confirms the fragility flagged in the previous read.

The bearish read has been revised, not confirmed: the 4H stays bearish but the combined signal has flipped to HOLD, the 1H trend has turned up, and price has pushed from 57.10 to 57.89 — reclaiming the 57.0865–57.1075 FVG that was the prior line in the sand and clearing the 57.2795–57.377 bearish FVG that was capping bounces. With no open FVGs and the 58.41 short entry now sitting at the lower pivot, the setup is expired and the bias is neutral, not short. The level that matters now is 58.41 — a sustained reclaim puts the 61.45 upper pivot in play and fully invalidates the old short thesis, while rejection there keeps the 4H bearish structure alive with 55.37 as the downside objective.

The 4H direction has flipped back to bearish, reversing the prior cautiously-long tilt and returning the combined read to HOLD — the previous bull FVGs at 4,153–4,157 have been consumed and replaced by a single bull gap at 4,160.90–4,163.27 now acting as support beneath price. Price has pushed up to 4,183.35, clearing the prior bearish FVG at 4,165.29–4,168.52 that had capped upside, so that reclaim is confirmed and the immediate bearish cap is gone even as the 4H trend leans down. The SELL setup remains invalidated with the 4,141.44 entry untouched, and the path toward the 4,217.40 upper pivot stays open while 4,160.90–4,163.27 holds. Invalidation: a sustained break below 4,141.44 re-arms the downside toward 4,065.48 and flips the combined read back to bearish.

Bias stays neutral-to-long but the fade below 1.353–1.3567 has cooled into a flat stall, with the last 1H at just -0.07% (1.33→1.33) versus the prior -0.40% down hour, while 4H direction remains the lone bearish counterweight and keeps the combined read at HOLD. The support shelf has thinned: the upper bull FVG at 1.3266–1.3291 is gone, leaving only the 1.3045–1.3218 zone over the 1.31 pivot. The SELL from 1.31 remains invalidated with nothing re-arming it while 1.31 holds. Invalidation: a push through 1.353–1.3567 opens 1.3668–1.3704 and keeps the bullish regime intact toward the 1.43 pivot; losing 1.31 revives the 1.20 target and the short with 1.37 as stop.
